operations.title: The C4 parallel infinity collision is Tate/Kummer generically
operations.body: Entry 1161 (event 910) resolves Entry 1160's 72 parallel pivots. For complementary intervals S,S^c, Q_{S^c}|_{Q_S=0}=s(X_{S^c}-X_S). The duplicated infinity mark is therefore the infinity Cartier/Tate divisor times a rank-one signed-energy Kummer letter, not a second elliptic curve. Enhancement is only on 2X_S-E=0, an existing signed-energy wall. The 36 unordered occurrences realize six complement partitions with full term provenance. Next: local Kato/Cech algebra at the forced triple concurrencies.
